input: palindrome is an ASCII lowercase palindrome of length n. Empty input is accepted as an impossible-case extension. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Lexicographically smallest non-palindrome obtainable by replacing exactly one character with an ASCII lowercase letter, or empty string when impossible.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; only private working state is used. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: ASCII lexical order agrees across languages. Changing the earliest non-a character in the first half to a gives the lexicographically optimal decreasing replacement; valid second-half changes cannot improve it. An odd middle position alone cannot break symmetry. All indices are exact. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n+1) time and O(n+1) auxiliary/output string storage, counting slicing and concatenation. The scan performs only one replacement construction. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 327 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
evidence_boundary: Authored permitted dev_fit alternative outside frozen source sets. Membership checked only against already-public cost-decomposition-v1/contract.json partition.dev_fit and candidate manifest. Input/effect/complexity declarations are not frozen-predecessor equivalence receipts. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed. Mandatory isolated judging remains blocked; private original source/case/receipt material is unavailable. Static syntax/metadata checks do not establish correctness. Independent source-bound isolated qualification must cover length0/1/2, all a, non-a only at odd center, early/late first-half change, output exactly one character different, actual return types, numerical/Unicode and effect contracts, full source/adapter charges and complexity before admission or promotion.
